A1.justification: Both complete PDFs describe the same POET-X work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–B support reliable comparison, including matching relocated tables and identifying v2's additional appendix experiment.

before.justification: V1 reports original kernel benchmarks, C4 pretraining perplexities, memory measurements, and throughput-scaling experiments in the main text and Appendix B.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results and adds Qwen3 dense and mixture-of-experts pretraining results in Appendix B, Table 15.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.6 retain the same input-centric computation, permutation optimizations, Cayley-Neumann implementation, checkpointing variants, and quantized POET-XQ. The Qwen3 experiments apply the existing method without documenting a new algorithmic component or adaptation.

E1.justification: Both versions specify C4 for all pretraining experiments in Appendix A and retain the same language-modeling task. Qwen3 dense and MoE are added model configurations; no new dataset, domain, task requirement, or input scenario is reported.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding original experiments. The additional Qwen3 comparisons reuse AdamW, an existing baseline. Newly cited SSO and Pion are discussed as related work but are not evaluated.

E3.justification: Appendix B adds experiments with 1B Qwen3 dense and 1B Qwen3 MoE models, each trained on 20B tokens. These introduce additional model configurations and training budgets within the retained task; existing Llama settings and evaluation protocols are otherwise retained.

E4.justification: The added Qwen3 experiment explicitly tests architectural generalization beyond Llama, including dense and MoE models, providing a limited additional applicability analysis. Existing component benchmarks, memory-efficiency studies, and throughput-scaling analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports training-seed counts, repeated-run variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Appendix A retains the same throughput measurement procedure: 100 warmup iterations followed by averaging over 20 steps.

E6.justification: Table 15 adds AdamW/POET-X perplexities of 14.78/14.67 and memory of 36.09/29.42 GB for Qwen3 dense, and 16.89/15.38 and 28.41/27.51 GB for Qwen3 MoE. Existing numerical results are unchanged. Table 10 corrects its final row's block-size attribution to b=512, already correctly identified in v1's Table 14.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(10), the backward-gradient derivation, spectrum-preservation reasoning, and Cayley-Neumann approximation are retained. No new theorem, proof, formal assumption, or mathematical definition appears in either appendix.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution statements retain the same claims about efficient spectrum-preserving training, 3x memory reduction and 8x speedup over POET, and single-H100 pretraining up to 13B parameters. The Qwen3 evidence does not redefine these main contributions.

C2.justification: Appendix B newly interprets the Qwen3 results as supporting architectural generalization and emphasizes the larger perplexity advantage for MoE. Existing efficiency explanations and computational trade-offs remain unchanged; the added generic Impact Statement supplies no substantive limitation.

D1.justification: Appendix A removes the explicit early-training clipping schedule: during the first 2,000 steps, the threshold was reset to 0.01 after merging and increased to 1.0 over 10 steps. This removes reproducibility information without establishing whether implementation changed. Software, hardware, code-access statements, and Tables 11–13 are retained.

R1.justification: Section 5 adds brief positioning among stable optimizers and new references to Jordan et al.'s Muon, SSO, and Pion. The sparse-training and low-rank research positioning remains intact. Updated Jaiswal and Hoffmann bibliography entries refer to the same previously cited works.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized grammar and terminology corrections, updates the affiliation and publication footer, and adds an Impact Statement and short Qwen3 appendix subsection. The original section order and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: V2 adds Table 15, relocates Table 8 from page 6 to page 7 and Table 9 from page 7 to page 8, and adjusts surrounding layout. Table 10 corrects the final POET-Xfast label from b=256 to b=512. Figures 1–7 retain their content.

improvement.justification: The added Qwen3 dense and MoE comparisons modestly strengthen evidence of applicability beyond Llama, while the Table 10 correction improves reporting accuracy. The gain is limited by the unexplained removal of the gradient-clipping detail and sparse documentation of the new experiments. The central method and original empirical evidence remain stable.
